title: The Animal That Poops in Cubes
hook: Your poop isn’t the only shape that matters.
script: Your poop isn’t the only shape that matters. What if yours came out as neat little cubes? A wombat’s does. Their intestine doesn’t just squeeze waste — it sculpts it into six-sided blocks. The last stretch of a wombat’s intestine has stiff and stretchy patches that mould the waste into cubes before it ever hits the ground. But here’s the even wilder part: they stack the cubes on rocks and logs to mark territory, and the cubes don’t roll away. And that means every wombat poop you’ve ever seen in a zoo isn’t just waste — it’s a deliberate message.
